answer: Sequential bond escalation: every new agent identity must lock a collateral bond growing quadratically with identities already attested from the same origin, costing 4x for the second and 9x for the third. Like water sinking through karst to bedrock, an attacker drains with each fork until the marginal identity costs more than the reward it extracts. Bonds sit in a time-locked vault releasing only after a horizon of 20 epochs, and any cluster caught attesting each other is slashed together, so a sybil farm risks its whole ocean of capital against detection.
